en.headline: Tang says bid-rigging task force is already a powerful deterrent
en.dek: Security Secretary Chris Tang warned that some syndicates now fabricate repair orders to pressure owners into unnecessary works, and urged owners to check the Buildings Department site.
body: Security Secretary Chris Tang said on Wednesday that the joint task force combating bid-rigging in building maintenance is already proving a powerful deterrent.

Speaking on an RTHK radio programme, Tang said investigators had found some syndicates no longer wait for a statutory repair order. Instead they tell owners that one has been issued and that immediate action is required or they risk breaking the law, when in fact no such order exists.

He said the groups exploit owners who lack the technical knowledge to verify the claim, sometimes by controlling owners’ corporations and property management companies. Tang urged owners to take a greater interest in maintenance matters and to check the Buildings Department website to confirm whether an order has actually been issued for their building.

Tang added that officers have been attending owners’ corporation meetings, sometimes in plain clothes, which has made those linked to syndicates become more restrained. He described the dual purpose as gathering intelligence and serving as a deterrent.

Investigators had also found some professionals colluding with syndicates and signing off without proper inspection, including one consultant handling as many as 90 projects at once. On the anti-bid-rigging hotline, Tang said reports had come from owners and professionals unwilling to collude, and he called its effectiveness significant.

zh.headline: 鄧炳強指打擊圍標特遣隊已起震懼作用
zh.dek: 保安局局長鄧炳強警告有集團虛擬維修令施壓業主，呼籲業主查核屋宇署網站確認令是否存在。
body: 保安局局長鄧炳強星期三表示，打擊樓宇維修圍標的聯合特遣隊已經起到強大的震懼作用。
鄧炳強在香港電台節目上說，調查人員發現部分集團不再等待法定維修令，而是直接告訴業主已獲發令，必須即時行動，否則違反法例，但事實上並無相關令。
他指，這些集團利用業主缺乏專業知識來核實的弱點，有時通過控制業主立案法團及物業管理公司施壓。鄧炳強呼籲業主更關心樓宇維修事務，並上屋宇署網站查詢有關令是否真正存在。
他补充，特遣隊人員會出席業主立案法團會議，有時以便服出席，令與集團有關聯的人士較為克制。這既可搜集情報，亦起到震懼作用。
調查也發現有專業人士與集團串謀，未經實地檢查便簽署文件，其中一名顧問同時處理多達90個項目。鄧炳強指反圍標熱線收到來自不願串謀的業主及專業人士的舉報，成效顯著。
